correctness.rationale: For line-graph vertices ij of K_n, closed-neighborhood parity is d_i+d_j+x_ij=1 over F2, D=sum_i d_i=0. For even n every d_i=1 and x_ij=1; for odd n any even-size set U={i:d_i=1} yields exactly edges internal to U and its complement, and every solution arises uniquely. The induced components are T_|U| and T_(n-|U|), giving the weight enumerator, minimum, exactly n+1 connected solutions and connectivity penalty. Independently enumerated all subsets for n=3,4,5,6 and their induced connectivity, matching counts 4/4,1/1,16/6,1/1. Note a duplicated alternative U definition in source proof is an editorial slip; its subsequent degree/converse calculation unambiguously uses U={d_i=1} and the theorem remains correct. All-parameter proof is algebraic, not based on enumeration.
